claude-opus-5-5.title: PARIS KIZOMBA NYE 10th KIZOMBA – KOMPA – URBANKIZ – BACHATA
claude-opus-5-5.description:
🔥 THE PKS EXPERIENCE CONTINUES… PARIS NYE 10! 🔥
❤️ PKS 2026 gave us unforgettable memories.
Beautiful dances, amazing connections, smiles, energy, good vibes… and above all, an incredible community united by dance. 🙏🏾
But the story doesn’t end with summer… ☀️
🎆 NEXT STOP: PARIS NYE 10 🇫🇷
📅 30 DEC 2026 → 4 JAN 2027
📍 PARIS, FRANCE
❤️ Same spirit. A brand-new experience
🥂 We welcome 2027 together in PARIS!

🔥 5 VIBES • ONE EXPERIENCE
💃 KIZOMBA
⚡ URBANKIZ

👀🔥 MORE TO BE ANNOUNCED!
⚖️ OUR GOAL: THE BEST POSSIBLE LEADER / FOLLOWER BALANCE
Great social dancing starts with the right balance on the dance floor.
🛡️ A SAFE & RESPECTFUL ENVIRONMENT
Respect, good vibes and real connections a space where everyone can enjoy the dance and feel comfortable.
🔥 Shows & special performances
🎉 Days & nights of dancing
🤝 Social vibes, sharing & beautiful connections
🥂 An unforgettable way to welcome 2027 in Paris
🇫🇷 AND PARIS IS PART OF THE EXPERIENCE! ❤️

✨ OPÉRA GARNIER or ⛪ NOTRE-DAME DE PARIS
You choose your Paris experience! 🇫🇷
🎁 And that’s not all… more surprises are coming!
Did you love the Summer Experience? ☀️
Then get ready for the New Year Experience!
🎆🔥
DANCE • BALANCE • CONNECTION • SAFE VIBES • PARIS
❤️ Come for the dance. Stay for the atmosphere.
🌍 PARIS NYE 10 — AROUND THE DANCE WORLD IN ONE NIGHT
